changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO arr_fs_link (dao_link_id, digital_repository_id, path) SELECT ll.dao_link_id, p.digital_repository_id, d.code FROM arr_legacy_dao_link ll JOIN arr_dao d ON d.dao_id = ll.dao_id JOIN arr_dao_package p ON p.dao_package_id = d.dao_package_id JOIN arr_digital_repository r ON r.external_system_id = p.digital_repository_id WHERE r.digital_repository_type = 'FILESYSTEM'; DELETE FROM arr_legacy_dao_link WHERE dao_link_id IN (SELECT dao_link_id FROM arr_fs_link);
